protocol: Outer whole-host holdout. Router/probe/reconstructor trained only on four source hosts. Reconstructor source inputs are probe predictions from inner whole-host probe fits. Test probe telemetry is replayed from archived records keyed to each source run; legacy probe timestamps do not establish that probes preceded their matching full runs. No fresh online target-host workload or paired timing is claimed.

policy_definitions.learned_router: Pointwise MLP trained to predict raw component scores from xi and component identity.
policy_definitions.learned_anchor_router: Pointwise MLP trained on component-to-suite log-scale closeness, weighted by training-fold probe reliability.
policy_definitions.learned_corr_reliability_router: Pointwise MLP trained on within-run component rank weighted by training-fold absolute Spearman association with suite score and probe reliability.
policy_definitions.score_ranked_fixed: Fixed Top-3 by mean component score in the outer training hosts.
policy_definitions.correlation_top3_fixed: Fixed Top-3 by absolute Spearman association between each component and suite score in the outer training hosts.
policy_definitions.fixed_first_three: The first three benchmark components in canonical test-id order.
policy_definitions.random_fixed: One seed-fixed random Top-3 per outer host fold.

limitations: Legacy archived probe timestamps are unavailable, so pre-run ordering and paired collection are not independently verified; this is not an online target-host timing experiment.
Five hosts with one five-run session each. Source-host folds are not independent sessions.
The primary learned_router uses component-score supervision. Anchor and correlation-plus-probe-reliability supervision are compared, but none is trained directly on held-out reconstruction error.
Reported probe-only wall fractions exclude xi collection and other orchestration overhead; archived probe wall times may not match a live pre-run workflow.
